rules.message: the open-source core never imports a commercial extension: expose a hook or a feature flag instead
catch a named exception (a bare except also swallows KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit)
use datetime.now(timezone.utc): utcnow() is naive and deprecated
core, helpers, storage and schema sit below the HTTP layer: move the shared code down, never import a router
read configuration through apowerb.configs.settings, not os.environ
log through apowerb.configs.th2logger; print() is for the CLI only
fix the type instead of silencing mypy
